sub_site: invasive breast tumour (4 spatial portions per tumour)

evidence.quote: Tumor specimens were prospectively collected at Sir Run Run Shaw Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine
perform 5R 16S rRNA amplification and sequencing that amplifies five regions of the 16S rRNA gene with multiplex amplification

controls.types: blank control; DNA extraction control; no-template control

evidence.quote: Different types of negative controls were used, such as blank controls, DNA extraction controls, and controls without templates were processed following the same protocol as the tumour samples

notes: 60 tumour pieces from 15 patients. Negative controls said to be 'processed following the same protocol' but no control sequencing results or decontamination reported, so coded included_not_sequenced (could be sequenced). Prevotella_7 also named (counted under Prevotella). Genus profile otherwise only in Fig. 1A/1D. F. nucleatum confirmed by RNAscope FISH/CISH.
